key_points: Media partner integrations drove 41% of qualified leads, with broadcast analytics showing highest conversion potential
Campaign engagement rates increased 34% across EMEA and APAC regions over the past 90 days
Proposed budget reallocation to prioritize high-performing channels and expand influencer partnership program
Brand awareness metrics indicate strong resonance with enterprise-level decision makers in publishing and streaming sectors
